_meta.description: Per-row principal component scores across revenue_before, revenue and session_minutes on experiment.pulse via ATTR_PC_SCORE. pc1 is each row's standardized score on the first component of their correlation (MAT_PCA's sign and order: it rises with the revenue pair, whose MAT_PCA loadings are about +0.99), averaging 0 with a standard deviation of 1 over all the fitted rows (here about -0.04 on control and +0.05 on variant). pc2_varimax scores the second of two varimax-rotated components (almost exactly session_minutes), fitted by fit_on on the control arm only while every row is still scored: it averages 0 on control by construction and about +0.47 standard deviations on variant. The fit is cohort-wide, never per treatment; grouping runs the request buffered.
_meta.name: attr_pc_score
